_doc: Every external host the code or the config names, and what it receives. tests/test_otari_report.py fails when a host appears in verdict_desk/*.py, tools/*.py or config/*.json without a row here or an entry in `ignore`.

hosts.receives: every prompt of every model call, the tool requests (search, fetch, sandbox code, MCP), and our end-user ids
hosts.region: derived from the base URL: a host that starts with eu. is the EU region, otherwise Otari's default (US) region

hosts.receives: the TypeScript price query the model writes and Otari sends; our code never contacts it
our IP address and the symbol asked for (no key)
our IP address and the instrument asked for (no key)
our IP address and the search words (no key)
hosts.when: every decision, unless news is off

hosts.receives: our IP address (a GET of the feed)
our IP address (a GET of the feed)
our IP address (a GET of the feed)
our IP address (a GET of the feed)
our IP address (a GET of the feed)
our IP address (a GET of a public preview page)
a lookup of a published head hash

hosts.what: the source repository and its workflow evidence
hosts.receives: git pushes of dossiers (branch otari) and reads of public pages
hosts.when: when a dossier is pushed or a witness is read

ignore.www.w3.org: an XML namespace string, never contacted
ignore.sepolia: a fragment of a host pattern in a comment, not a host
ignore.t: a fragment of t.me patterns, not a host
ignore.claude.ai: text of a commit trailer written by the runner, never contacted
